lessons.0.slides.1.title: 📋 Assessment Scope
lessons.0.slides.1.content:
This comprehensive assessment covers every module in the Level 2 course:

• M1 Côte de Nuits In-Depth Analysis
• M2 Côte de Beaune: White Wine Sanctuaries
• M3 Terroir and Soil Science
• M4 Complete Grand Cru Guide
• M5 Premier Cru Selection Analysis
• M6 Climate and Vintage Interpretation
• M7 Advanced Tasting Techniques
• M8 Domaines and Winemakers

The bank contains 31 questions; the system randomly draws 20. Passing score: 80 or above.

lessons.0.slides.2.points.3: Classification: 33 Grands Crus, Premier Cru labeling rules, Clos de Vougeot ownership
